notable_absence.finding: THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT FINDING IN THIS BATCH FOR THIS WAVE'S PRIORITY. This page has NO version statement about itself at all. CREATE VECTOR INDEX is a brand-new 8.0 statement - it does not exist in the 7.2 or 7.6 trees, and the only place the batch documents its era is on a *different* page (createindex.md: 'In Couchbase Server 8.0 and later, the CREATE INDEX statement also allows you to create Composite Vector indexes'). So there is no quotable evidence on this page for `n1ql:create-vector-index availableSince version:server-8-0`, and under the brief's hard rule (evidence must be a direct quote from the page) I have NOT asserted it. The only version gate the page carries is 7.6.2, and it is about defer_build's default, i.e. a version PREDATING the statement's own existence. Reconciliation should treat 'a page introducing a new statement carries no availableSince for itself' as the dominant failure mode: availableSince is populated by *incidental* prose in older pages that had to warn about mixed-version clusters, not by new-feature pages, which read as if the feature were timeless. Deriving availableSince reliably will need tree-presence diffing (page absent in 7.2/7.6, present in 8.0) rather than page text.

cross_product_finding: The Capella twin exists (cloud/n1ql/n1ql-language-reference/createvectorindex.md) and, like the Capella createindex page, carries a version gate this Server page does not: 'In clusters running Couchbase Server versions 7.6.0 and 7.6.1, you cannot use this option to choose which Index Service nodes contain the index. Clusters running Couchbase Server 7.6.2 and later do not have this restriction.' The Server 8.0 nodes description has no such sentence. Same asymmetry as createindex: the Capella docs are more version-explicit than the versioned Server docs because they serve a mixed-version fleet. The Capella page also omits the ENTERPRISE EDITION / COMMUNITY EDITION badges on nodes and num_replica that this page carries, and says 'Couchbase Capella uses the following strings to represent the distance metrics' where Server says 'Couchbase Server uses the following strings' - a pure product-name substitution in otherwise identical text. Prerequisites diverge on the expected axis: Server names privilege:query-manage-index; Capella names Basic->Write / Advanced->Query Index. Do not merge.
version_finding: Vector search turns out to be the OPPOSITE of prime availableSince territory, contrary to the batch brief's expectation. Neither vector index page states its own availability version. The only explicit 8.0 gate anywhere in this batch is on createindex.md, and it gates the Composite Vector *capability added to an existing statement* - precisely because that statement predates 8.0 and therefore needed a 'and later' qualifier. New statements introduced wholesale at 8.0 (CREATE VECTOR INDEX, DROP VECTOR INDEX, ALTER VECTOR INDEX) carry no version marker whatsoever. Corollary for the ontology: availableSince evidence density is inversely correlated with how new a feature is. Also note that the sole version gate on this page, 7.6.2 for defer_build's default, is inherited boilerplate shared verbatim with createindex.md and refers to a release in which this statement did not exist - a mild content defect worth flagging: the 'Defer Index Builds by Default' section was copied onto a page whose statement is newer than the version it cites.
